Now we need to apply template 1914397 to something (maybe the nitro product). Then 1914398, then 1914399, then 74054. We need to produce a tree with 6 reactions sequentially, each reaction node with children being precursors.

We need to ensure each template matches the molecule we feed. We need to check matching before applying.
